name: Does the fine-tuned gemma3-270m proofreader (train-proofreader-gemma270m-v1) generalize to realistic, independently-diversified English text, or does it reproduce the formalizer-wild-v1 futility finding of eval-proofreader-e2e-v1?
registered_by: proofing-data-agent (owner task: eval-proofreader-e2e-v1 found the fine-tuned proofreader helps generator-distribution suites -- formalizer-v1 +6.67pp [4,9.67], formalizer-ood-v1 +2.84pp [1.77,4] -- but is null/futile on formalizer-wild-v1, independently-written text (-1pp [-3,0]). The hypothesis under test is that datasets/proofing was built only from generator text, so the model learned to repair generator style rather than general English noise. This file builds a NEW held-out set of realistic, diverse English text with a gold SOP -- Haiku-diversified formalizer-v1 train-row paraphrases (DS022 'LLM diversification', owner decision D2) that pass llm-diversify's own anchors/cues/execution/no-copy/judge filters -- and measures whether the existing fine-tuned model helps on it, never touching eval/suites/** including formalizer-wild-v1 itself.)
question: On a held-out set of Haiku-diversified formalizer-v1 paraphrases (realistic register, typos, fragments and word-order variation, never used to build datasets/proofing and disjoint by split_group_id from any row used to build datasets/proofing v2), does wiring the fine-tuned gemma3-270m proofreader ahead of the frozen UD-to-SOP rules v1.4 produce a real strict-accuracy gain (always-on and a gate_no_spacy proxy), and how does it compare to an untrained Qwen3-1.7B zero-shot reference (PROMPTS.proof)?
frozen_before_results: Written after: building the diverse-dev held-out split (tools/research/split-diverse-dev.mjs, a pure deterministic function of split_group_id, computed without looking at any model's output) from the combined pool of eval/reports/current/llm-diversify/pilot/accepted.jsonl (274 rows, existing before this task) and eval/reports/current/llm-diversify/diverse-dev-batch/accepted.jsonl (695 rows, new batch this task, seed 20260930, cost $3.9075); computing and recording diverse-dev.jsonl's sha256 below (dev_fraction 0.70, chosen only to clear the >=400-EN-rows target, before any row's question was parsed or any model was called). Written before: running tools/research/diverse-dev-eval.mjs (no arm's SOP has been generated or scored for any diverse-dev row); building any datasets/proofing v2 addition from the disjoint 'candidates' half of the pool (that build depends only on the frozen rules oracle and small-candidate/teacher rewrites, never on this file's own diverse-dev results, so there is no data leakage between the two, but it is sequenced strictly after this file for a clean audit trail).

hypotheses.H1: The always-on fine-tuned-proofreader arm's strict-match delta on diverse-dev (paired cluster bootstrap, cluster=split_group_id) is smaller than the generator-distribution gain (formalizer-v1 +6.67pp, formalizer-ood-v1 +2.84pp) and may be null or negative like formalizer-wild-v1's -1pp [-3,0], because diverse-dev's surface text is written by an independent process (Haiku paraphrase, explicitly instructed to vary register, word order, typos and length) the way formalizer-wild-v1's human writers wrote independently, not by the generator whose style the proofing corpus was built from.
hypotheses.H2: The gate_no_spacy proxy keeps the always-on arm's break rate no higher while capturing a similar or smaller share of any repair benefit, replicating the generator-distribution gating pattern directionally.
hypotheses.H3: The untrained Qwen3-1.7B zero-shot reference (PROMPTS.proof) performs worse than or comparably to the fine-tuned 270M on diverse-dev, matching the unconditional full-sealed-test finding (qwen3-1.7b:proof net +6.43pp vs the fine-tuned model's +10.4pp on eval/suites/proofing/test.jsonl) -- not assumed either way, since diverse-dev is out of both models' training distribution in different ways (the 270M was fine-tuned on generator-style noise; Qwen3-1.7B was never fine-tuned on this task at all).
hypotheses.non_claim: This file does not claim a result for Romanian or mixed-language rows (diverse-dev's EN slice only, matching eval-proofreader-e2e-v1's own EN-only scope for the English-text proofreader); it does not by itself authorize a retrain -- task 5/report-v2.md's recommendation is advisory only, any retrain needs a new, separate owner 'yes' (AGENTS.md rule 3).

arms.name: no_rewrite
arms.source: the diverse-dev row's own question, parsed by the frozen rules v1.4 snapshot directly

arms.name: gemma_always_on
arms.kind: the trained checkpoint (models/gemma/proofreader-gemma270m-v1/proofreader/merged-best), message-only HF-transformers generation on CUDA, matching training exactly (training/python/generate_causal.py)

arms.name: gemma_gate_no_spacy
arms.kind: same checkpoint, offline uncertainty-gate proxy (unparsed wire, converter repair/fallback, or an OOV lowercase word not in the system dictionary -- identical construction to eval-proofreader-e2e-v1's gate_no_spacy)

arms.name: qwen_proof
arms.kind: untrained Qwen3-1.7B (models/proofing/qwen3-1.7b), PROMPTS.proof, protect/restore around names and literals -- the same zero-shot small-candidate mechanism tools/research/proofing.mjs uses to build datasets/proofing itself, reused here as a reference arm, always-on (no gating variant)

changed_factor: Whether and how the English text is rewritten before the frozen UD-to-SOP rules v1.4 parse it (arms 2-4) versus not (arm 1); arm 4 (Qwen3-1.7B) is an additional reference point, not a controlled ablation of arms 2-3.

diverse_dev.provenance: Haiku-diversified (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) paraphrases of datasets/formalizer-v1 train-split rows (DS022 'LLM diversification'; tools/datasets/llm-diversify/pipeline.mjs paraphrase, owner decision D2), from two runs: the existing pilot (eval/reports/current/llm-diversify/pilot, 300 sampled source rows, seed 20260929, 274 accepted) and a new batch this task (eval/reports/current/llm-diversify/diverse-dev-batch, 800 sampled source rows, seed 20260930, 695 accepted, $3.9075 spent). Every row already passed llm-diversify's own anchors/cues/execution/no_copy_sources/no_copy_sealed/not_duplicate/judge filters before being pooled here. Gold SOP is inherited unchanged from the source formalizer-v1 row (never regenerated). NEVER eval/suites/** (including formalizer-wild-v1, whose independent-writer futility finding this file investigates without touching the sealed suite itself).
diverse_dev.split: tools/research/split-diverse-dev.mjs: deterministic fnv1a hash of split_group_id, dev_fraction 0.70 (chosen only to clear >=400 EN rows), disjoint from the 189-EN-row 'candidates' half used (separately, sequenced after this file) to build datasets/proofing v2 additions -- so no row's surface text is both evaluated here and trained on in v2. candidates.jsonl sha256 aad0524da088fda4585fe5bcf61aeffb1af00a0c5d273170f862dc1cf678c547.
diverse_dev.oracle: frozen-rules-v1.4 (eval/reports/current/baseline-ud-rules/frozen-rules-v1.4, SHA256SUMS-checked copy loaded via tools/research/proofing-oracle.mjs loadFrozenRules -- never the live lib/ud-to-sop, which another agent may be concurrently changing); strict = execution_equivalent (eval/run.mjs evaluate(), DS016) against the row's own (inherited) gold SOP

data.leakage_check: tools/datasets/audit/proofing-overlap.mjs-style exact-match and 8-gram overlap against eval/suites/formalizer-v1, formalizer-ood-v1 and formalizer-wild-v1 test.jsonl, plus split_group_id disjointness against datasets/proofing/{train,dev,hard_cases}.jsonl (the v1 corpus) and against the v2 'candidates' half -- reported regardless of outcome

metrics: strict and tolerant accuracy per arm with 95% CI where useful, paired cluster-bootstrap 95% CI of each rewrite arm's strict delta vs no_rewrite (cluster=split_group_id, 10,000 resamples, seed 7, tools/research/diverse-dev-eval.mjs bootstrapDelta -- same method as eval-proofreader-e2e-v1's tools/research/proofreader-e2e-frozen-rules-eval.mjs), break rate on rows no_rewrite already got right, gained/lost row counts (McNemar), 30 random before/after examples of changed rows.

stopping_rules.stages: 100, 300, then the full EN row count (tools/research/grammar-constrained-eval.mjs stratifiedOrder, seed 20260930), paired cluster-bootstrap CI on the gemma_always_on-minus-no_rewrite strict delta recomputed after each stage
stopping_rules.decisive: stop when the 95% CI of that delta lies entirely above +1.5pp (decisive-positive) or entirely below 0pp (decisive-negative)
stopping_rules.futility: stop when the CI's upper bound is below +0.5pp (a practically useful gain is excluded)
stopping_rules.broken: stop and report if more than 20% of the first 100 rows produce an empty rewrite from either generation arm
stopping_rules.record: every stop recorded with its stage, numbers and reason in the journal, the topic notes (topic proofing), the experiment record and eval/reports/current/proofing/report-v2.md

decision_rule: report-v2.md's retrain recommendation is advisory only; no retrain, tuning or default-behavior change happens as a direct effect of this file (AGENTS.md rule 3: retraining needs a new, separate owner 'yes'; every arm here is inference-only, no optimizer step, no --resume).
non_goals: no rule changes to lib/ud-to-sop; no tuning on any sealed suite or on diverse-dev itself; no re-training of any model; eval/suites/** (including formalizer-wild-v1) is never read as data or for tuning by this file or by the v2 dataset build it precedes.
